# Requirements Quality Checklist: Reading Tracker

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the spec's requirements before proceeding to `/speckit-tasks` (author self-review, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-08-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are well-written — it does not test the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what happens when an Open Library search result is missing a required field, such as author? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is there a requirement bounding total pages on the upper end, or is ">0" the only constraint intentionally? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the UI shows while a search request is in flight? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for concurrent modification of the same book from two open tabs or windows? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a requirement defined for the order in which the personal list is displayed (e.g., by add date, title, category)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "clear error message," used across FR-003/FR-005/FR-013/FR-015, defined with any consistent content or format expectation, or left fully to implementer discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the search-result cap of "approximately 20" precise enough to be objectively verified, or does "approximately" leave the exact number ambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "session," as used for the search cache lifetime, defined precisely enough to distinguish it from a browser session versus the server process's lifetime? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do FR-009 (category change to "finished" sets 100%) and FR-010 (page updates never change category) together describe every way progress and category can interact, with no remaining contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the duplicate-prevention rules in FR-005 fully consistent with the removal rules in FR-011 — i.e., does removal unambiguously clear the uniqueness constraint? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "clear error message" expectation applied consistently to every validation rule listed in FR-013, or only to some of them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can SC-001's "under 30 seconds" be objectively measured given it spans the user's own search-and-decide time, not just system response time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 Is SC-006 ("without consulting any instructions") stated in a way that can be objectively verified, or does it require a subjective judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Does every functional requirement (FR-001–FR-018) map to at least one measurable success criterion or acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are exception-flow requirements defined for every external-dependency failure mode (timeout, non-2xx response, malformed response), or only for a generic "unavailable" case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 Are recovery requirements defined for what the user can do immediately after a failed search, beyond seeing the error message? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the zero-state (no books ever added) across the list, filter, and statistics views? [Coverage, Edge Case]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a search query containing only whitespace, distinguishing it from a genuinely empty query? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for non-integer or non-numeric input to the total-pages or current-page fields, beyond the numeric range check? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how unusually long title or author strings from Open Library should be displayed? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Are the "identifying request headers" and "rate limit" obligations in FR-017 quantified within the requirement itself (specific header content, requests-per-second figure), or left unspecified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK022 Are performance expectations defined for how quickly the personal list and statistics views must respond, independent of Open Library's own response time? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for how large the personal list can grow before persistence or display requirements are affected? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption that progress percentage is "rounded to a whole number" cross-checked against how the average-progress statistic should round, to confirm the same rule applies? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the dependency on Open Library's cover-image and work-ID fields being present and stable in search responses documented as an assumption? [Dependency, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that the app is used by one person at a time, with no simultaneous multi-tab or multi-device edits, explicitly stated as a scope boundary? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Does the spec state whether total pages can be edited after a book is added, or is this intentionally left out of scope? [Gap, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified whether the average-progress statistic should include "reading" books at exactly 0% progress, or exclude them? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
